consumer_contract.consumer_expectation: Agent-runtime canaries bind the exact abyss-stack source ref, release manifest, signed subject inventory, host-managed trust root, materialized release-manifest subject, and fresh runtime_canary trust-gate verdict before activation.

consumer_command: abyss-machine artifacts build-sidecars --manifest manifests/artifact_bundles/abyss_stack_external_codex_agent.bundle.json --bundle-dir BUNDLE_DIR --subject-root RELEASE_ROOT --owner-repo OWNER_REPO --source-ref SOURCE_REF --json

abyss-machine artifacts evidence-promote BUNDLE_DIR --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --lifecycle-state manually-verified --consumer-ref abyss-stack:external-codex-agent-canary --evidence-ref owner-validator:OWNER_REPO:external-codex-agent-release --source-repo OWNER_REPO --source-ref SOURCE_REF --subject-root RELEASE_ROOT --producer abyss-stack-external-codex-agent-installer --trust-root-mode host_managed --json

abyss-machine artifacts materialize-subjects BUNDLE_DIR --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --store-root SUBJECT_STORE_ROOT --manifest manifests/artifact_bundles/abyss_stack_external_codex_agent.bundle.json --subject-root RELEASE_ROOT --consumer-intent runtime_canary --source-repo OWNER_REPO --source-ref SOURCE_REF --trust-root-mode host_managed --json

abyss-machine artifacts evidence-promote BUNDLE_DIR --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --lifecycle-state manually-verified --consumer-ref abyss-stack:external-codex-agent-canary --evidence-ref owner-validator:OWNER_REPO:external-codex-agent-release --source-repo OWNER_REPO --source-ref SOURCE_REF --subject-root RELEASE_ROOT --producer abyss-stack-external-codex-agent-installer --trust-root-mode host_managed --json

abyss-machine artifacts trust-gate --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class runtime_or_container_artifact --consumer-intent runtime_canary --source-repo OWNER_REPO --source-ref SOURCE_REF --trust-root-mode host_managed --subject-digest SUBJECT_DIGEST --json

abyss-machine artifacts registry-latest --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class runtime_or_container_artifact --consumer-intent runtime_canary --source-repo OWNER_REPO --source-ref SOURCE_REF --trust-root-mode host_managed --json
